speaker: President Henry B. Eyring
title: “Fear Not, I Am with Thee”
session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: President Henry B. Eyring spoke about ““Fear Not, I Am with Thee””.

quotes.text: My beloved brothers and sisters, I am grateful to be with you in this worldwide conference of The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints. The hymn we just heard sung by the choir speaks of promises which will become more important and more precious in the time ahead for all of us and for those we love.
quotes.speaker: President Henry B. Eyring
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Years later I realized that as she spoke those words to me, she was passing through tests of her own and rising up through a lifetime of terrible medical trials. As a girl, she had been diagnosed with diseases that would cause lifelong health challenges. But because she knew the words “Fear not, I am with thee” were true, the Lord’s promise was fulfilled for her.
quotes.speaker: President Henry B. Eyring
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: You might reasonably wonder why a loving and all-powerful God allows our mortal test to be so hard. It is because He knows that we must grow in spiritual cleanliness and stature to be able to live in His presence. To make that possible, Heavenly Father gave us a Savior and the power to choose for ourselves by faith to keep His commandments and to repent and to come unto Him.
quotes.speaker: President Henry B. Eyring
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: As my mother went through her last days of life, she became bedridden. The only picture she had placed on her bedroom wall was of the Savior. It hung where she could see it as she lay in her bed.
quotes.speaker: President Henry B. Eyring
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Now, I tell that story to offer evidence that the Lord sends faithful disciples to help Him keep His promise to succor others in their distress. As President Spencer W. Kimball taught: “God does notice us, and he watches over us. But it is usually through another person that he meets our needs.”
quotes.speaker: President Henry B. Eyring
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: You have prayed in faith consistently for your family members or friends to know who the Lord would have you help for Him. As a face or a name has come into your mind, you have reached out to them. Even your simple attention was a comfort. That you felt prompted to reach out to them was evidence to them that the Lord knew and loved them.
quotes.speaker: President Henry B. Eyring
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Your kindness to them, even for a few seconds, or simply a warm smile can be a strengthening of their faith that the Lord is watching over them. When you speak to them, you will find words to build their faith that the Lord knows them and is aware of their circumstances.
quotes.speaker: President Henry B. Eyring
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: You are an important part of the Lord’s answers to their prayers for assurance. As you show your appreciation and confidence in them that they have been inspired, they will feel evidence that God called them, knows them, and has guided and blessed them. They will be strengthened in their feeling of the Lord’s approval.
quotes.speaker: President Henry B. Eyring
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
